basis: claim graph v1 (2026-10-21): v0 plus authority-id entity merging. Only AUTHORITY-VERIFIED ids drive merging (POTS v1.1: ontology_id_verification == authority_verified, 5,727 rows; the 16,662 unverified_model_emitted ids are ignored — they contain wrong ids, e.g. CHEBI:145994 shared by remdesivir, pembrolizumab and nirmatrelvir-ritonavir; EDS ids are all authority-resolved). Strings resolving to the same id are one entity; unresolved strings keep the v0 skeleton. Supplement rows included. support_frac_of_condition_papers = supporting papers / papers in that corpus x condition cell. Verified ids are propagated to spellings that share the same v0 skeleton as a resolved spelling (case/punctuation variants), so an unresolved 'warfarin' joins a resolved 'Warfarin'.
finding_about_pots_v1_1: A first pass that used ALL POTS ids (including unverified_model_emitted) produced 454 merges with no shared token among the spellings; restricting to authority_verified removed them. The unverified ids are already flagged as such in the POTS package; this is a concrete reason never to use them for joins.
caveats: merging covers only entity rows with a verified id (~24% of POTS entity rows with any id are verified; EDS ~28% of entity rows resolved); unresolved spellings remain separate
token-disjoint merges are mostly legitimate abbreviation/synonym pairs (PGE2 / prostaglandin E2, DOPA / levodopa) but are listed for audit
contradictions remain candidates for reading, not verdicts
